verdict: Lead volume is healthy and cost per lead beats the industry, but zero pipeline value tracked means revenue is invisible.
diagnosis: This period delivered 48 paid leads at $158 average cost, but the CRM shows $0 opportunity value — the reporting loop is broken.

signals.headline: 48 paid leads at $158 each
signals.detail: Paid social generated 48 leads on $7,596 spend this period. Cost sits near the industry average for this trade.

signals.headline: 83 call clicks from Google profile
signals.detail: The Google Business Profile drove 83 calls and 90 direction requests. This is your strongest and cheapest lead channel right now.

signals.headline: Perfect 5.0 rating across 801 reviews
signals.detail: Review volume grew by 10 this period at a five-star average. This directly lifts local ranking and call volume.

signals.headline: $0 revenue tracked on opportunities
signals.detail: Every open opportunity shows zero dollar value. Without ticket amounts, you cannot measure return on ad spend or channel profitability.

signals.headline: 573 link clicks, 92 website clicks
signals.detail: Traffic to the site is thin relative to spend. Landing page speed and call-to-action clarity are worth an audit.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.subheader: Industry cost per lead sits near $150
benchmark.body: The 2026 industry average cost per HVAC lead is around $153, with non-branded paid search averaging $149 per lead. Your $158 result is within range but not yet best-in-class.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.body: Cost per click spikes in summer for cooling services, and conversion rates climb during heatwaves. This window is the highest-intent period of the year for AC repair leads.

competitor.label: COMPETITOR
competitor.subheader: Private equity rollups raise the auction
competitor.body: Private equity-backed HVAC consolidators are outbidding independents to capture market share. Independents win by responding faster: 78% of customers hire the first company that replies.

recommendations.title: Fix opportunity value tracking in the CRM
recommendations.detail: Every open opportunity shows $0. Consider requiring a ticket estimate at intake so you can measure which channels actually produce revenue, not just leads.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads alongside Meta
recommendations.detail: Local Services Ads run $25 to $85 per lead for this trade and appear above regular results. Worth testing given your five-star profile already qualifies.

recommendations.title: Split the campaign by service line
recommendations.detail: One broad HVAC campaign can cost 27% more per lead than separate AC repair, heating, and tune-up campaigns. Test splitting to lower cost per lead.
